headline: 7 core protocol contracts discovered across 6 chains: GAIB token, AID/sAID on Ethereum; multi-chain AID via LayerZero OFT
short_headline: 7 contracts across 6 chains; AID/sAID/GAIB token identified

findings.text: Etherscan name-tag search found GAIB token at 0xC19D38925F9F645337B1D1f37bAf3C0647A48E50 on Ethereum; symbol GAIB with 1B fixed supply, launched November 18, 2025.

GAIB docs confirm deployed contracts across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, BNB Chain, Story Protocol, and Sei. Official blog post documents core addresses: AID (0x18F52B3fb465118731d9e0d276d4Eb3599D57596) and sAID (0xB3B3c527BA57cd61648e2EC2F5e006A0B390A9F8) on Ethereum as OFT standard.
Audit references found in docs.gaib.ai/products/gaib-products/audit.md naming AIDa Vault audit and AID/sAID audit reports; PDFs via document IDs not directly accessible but cited.
GitHub repo (gaib-ai) exists but access blocked; deployment artifacts not retrievable this run. GitHub path should be re-attempted with search-backed discovery in future run.

Multi-chain deployment confirmed for 6 chains: Ethereum (mainnet, sAID-first), Arbitrum, Base, BNB Chain, Story Protocol, Sei. AID and sAID use LayerZero OFT standard for omnichain deployment—same contract address across chains.
No factory pattern or child contract enumeration identified in available sources. Protocol uses singleton ERC-20/ERC-4626 vault design, not factory-spawned pools.

Role taxonomy: GAIB token = governance/staking token; AID = core synthetic stablecoin asset; sAID = yield-bearing vault token (ERC-4626). No identified admin multisig or proxy-admin addresses in this run.
Three addresses traced to fetched blog and documentation: two Ethereum contract addresses from official blog.gaib.ai, one Ethereum GAIB token from web search citing verified Etherscan data.

evidence.shows: GAIB token contract verified on Etherscan at 0xC19D38925F9F645337B1D1f37bAf3C0647A48E50; blockchain-agnostic protocol operates on Ethereum; launched November 18, 2025.

Official GAIB blog confirms AID and sAID contract addresses: AID 0x18F52B3fb465118731d9e0d276d4Eb3599D57596, sAID 0xB3B3c527BA57cd61648e2EC2F5e006A0B390A9F8; both deployed on Ethereum as OFT standard via LayerZero for omnichain; sAID initially Ethereum-only with Q4 2025 rollout to other chains.
Official sAID contract address on Ethereum: 0xB3B3c527BA57cd61648e2EC2F5e006A0B390A9F8; ERC-4626 vault token representing share in AI/Robotics infrastructure financing portfolio.
Audit page lists AIDa Vault audit and AID/sAID audit reports with document file references; PDFs not directly fetched but audit citations recorded.
AID Alpha launched May 12, 2025 across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, BNB Chain, Story Protocol, Plume, and Sei; chain-specific vaults for ERC-4626 receipt tokens.
Blockchain networks listed: Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, SEI; Sherlock Security review audit mentioned.

GAIB Chain (L2 Settlement Hub) built on OP Stack; deployment across ecosystems including Ethereum, Solana, L2 networks; multi-chain interoperability via LayerZero OFT standard and IBC-style messaging.

protocol_metadata.about: GAIB is a decentralized finance protocol that tokenizes real-world AI infrastructure—GPUs and robotics—into on-chain yield-generating assets. Users stake AID (AI Dollar, a synthetic stablecoin) to receive sAID, a liquid vault token earning yield from GPU financing deals, data center operations, and robotics cash flows. The GAIB token governs the protocol via veGAIB voting and secures the network through EigenLayer/Symbiotic restaking.
